title: Meet the Swordmaster
description: Talk with the Swordmaster and learn ls -l

story: You see a Masked Swordmaster watching you.
Eleanor: "Listen to what he has to say."
Swordmaster: "Child, why do you seek me?"
1: I want to unlock the private section in the library.
2: Who are you?
3: Have you been leaving me strange notes?
Eleanor: "Tell him about the library! Use 'echo 1'"
Swordmaster: "Well, if you unlocked the chest in the cave,"
"then you already know how."
"A note of caution: what is inside is both powerful and dangerous."
Eleanor: "What's so dangerous?"
1: What is inside the library that is so dangerous?
2: Why do you live so far from other people?
3: Do you know why people are disappearing?
Use 'echo 3' to ask about the disappearances.
hints: Use 'echo 3' to ask about the disappearances.

story: Swordmaster: "I wasn't aware people were disappearing."
"Is that what is causing that bell?"
"Perhaps it is good you are here then."
"Tell me, what is your name?"
Eleanor: "Tell him your name! Use 'echo player'"
hints: Use 'echo player' to give your name.

story: Swordmaster: "I thought you might be."
"Few have the power to use the commands you used earlier."
"How did I know your name? Use 'ls -l' to see."
Eleanor: "A new command! Let's try it."
NEW POWER: Use 'ls -l' to see detailed file information
including permissions and ownership.
You see 'player' listed as the owner of files!
Swordmaster: "Your name is written in this world."
"...why is there a note in this room?"
"Do you see it? Use 'cat note' to examine it."
hints: Use 'cat note' to read the mysterious note.
